The '''Spaceport prefect's office''' of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] was located in [[Straight Street/Legends|Straight Street]], near [[Lup's Wares and Supplies]].<ref name="ItWoSWT" /> It was guarded by two [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]].
